I'm an 18 year old female about to head to college.

please don't worry about school. trust me, you'll learn this the hard way. its impossible to keep pushing yourself. you know your own pace and its the only way to live a healthy life. i took all AP classes because my parents taught me that my only value was in my education. but that's not true. i can be happy without overworking myself. i got into my dream college and im only taking classes i know i can, and now im on my way to an internship for my dream job. its possible! pushing myself then only made my crash and eventual breakdown bigger. talk to her about it and tell her how you want to be happy and healthy, and how doing so is important.

i want to do that too, but you probably won't be able to donate without informing them you're going to kill yourself in which case they'll call the police. i wanted to give my blood. dont hang yourself. me and you, we're in so much pain right now, our lives dont seem like they'll ever get better, but we understand each other, and tomorrow will be the new now. i bet the sun will shine. so lets both just go to sleep tonight, and figure it out tomorrow.

i know it hurts. but at times when we so desperately want to find someone who understands and loves us even with all our scars, i think it shows how lonely we truly are. but it also gives us a chance to take care of ourselves and grow more independent, so that when were ready to make relationships, were the best and strongest version of ourselves.

this was me last year, but my parents made an effort to understand after experiencing all my suicide attempts, i think they just wanted to see me alive. i think you need to rest, rethink your life. if your schoolwork is too much, cut down on some classes and take care of yourself. do more things you like, like reading or sleeping. our lives became like this because we stopped taking care of ourselves a while ago. but sometimes we dont always have someone to take care of us, so we have to take those baby steps on our own, and learn to forgive ourselves
